audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says 'Level 1 favours you', and 2+ items read Skill while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Sylas outscales you outright.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Volibear rows 0-5 and Sylas row 6, matching the prose exactly on a 50.99% lane you win early and lose late.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Volibear, row 6 to Sylas, paired across both layers with ratings adjusted. Rows 1-5 were already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hijack was mentioned only as 'his stolen ult' with no cooldown, so the level-6 spike had no timing behind it.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s and it takes YOUR Stormbringer. At rank 1 that is an 80s window in which he holds a copy of your engage — so the sequencing rule is that he spends his ult before you spend yours, not the reverse.
audit.corrected: 80s Hijack written into the don'ts and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond/Abduct was described as 'his dash + stun (recast pull)' in four places.
audit.why: Abscond is a dash; the Abduct recast throws his chains and pulls SYLAS to the enemy he hits. There is no stun anywhere in the ability and the kit carries no hardCC flag on his E. Advice built on 'don't charge Q into ready CC' is therefore aimed at CC that does not exist — the real reason to respect it is that it is his 13/12/11/10/9s escape.
audit.corrected: Stun removed, dash-and-pull stated, 13s rank-1 cooldown given as the commit window. Also named Petricite Burst as the reason his autos hurt after each spell.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond: 13s at rank 1, a dash whose Abduct recast pulls him to you — there is no stun on it. - Sylas Hijack: 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abscond is 13s at rank 1, and the Abduct recast only pulls him to you — it does not stun.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Q-stun + W reset bite.
edits.after: Track Sylas's Abscond: 13s at rank 1, a dash whose Abduct recast pulls him to you but never stuns. Hijack is 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: Charging Q into a waiting Abscond / Abduct — losing the stun before you land it means you took the whole trade for nothing and your W mark expires un-cashed.
edits.after: Ulting first at 6 — Hijack is only 80s at rank 1 and it steals Stormbringer, so make him spend it before you ever commit your own leap into him.

edits.before: Poke with Q Chain Lash and dodge your Q via double E
edits.after: Cycle spells so Petricite Burst empowers his autos

notes: The entry claims in three fields that your Q stun 'cancels' or 'interrupts' Kingslayer's swing. Kingslayer is a lunge with no channel flag in the kit and Riot's text says nothing about interruptibility, so I left those strings untouched rather than assert it. The mirror audit (sylas__volibear) records a different chart again (Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Sylas, Skill, Skill) which contradicts both packet.levelChart and the prose on this page; I followed packet plus prose.
